proof: Real child using the blocks across several play styles; no before/after or comparison.

ending_and_cta: Last 3 s: finished castle, no text. Voiceover end line is about Bliss being perfect for little ones combining development and design (machine transcript, garbled). No CTA in video or caption.
convincing: Interpretation: the toddler's real, uncoached-looking play and the satisfying castle make the product's value clear without needing words.
weak_or_overproduced: Interpretation: the script is generic ad copy ('חוויה התפתחותית שלמה'), there is no price or link, and the very styled home and matching outfits read as a staged brand collaboration.
lumebook_lesson: Interpretation: open on the finished satisfying result (the child with the finished book) then show how it arrived; one text card with the brand name early. A phone on a tripod with the child's natural play is enough.
